model_long_short.name: model_long_short
model_long_short.label: Direction, long/short
model_long_short.description: 100% long when the model's P(up) > 50%, 100% short otherwise.

model_long_flat.name: model_long_flat
model_long_flat.label: Direction, long/flat
model_long_flat.description: 100% long when P(up) > 50%, in cash otherwise.

vol_target_model.name: vol_target_model
vol_target_model.label: Volatility target (model)
vol_target_model.description: Long, sized to a 1.85% daily risk target (AAPL's 2016-2023 sd) using the model's forecast sd; capped at 1.5x.

vol_target_trailing.name: vol_target_trailing
vol_target_trailing.label: Volatility target (trailing vol)
vol_target_trailing.description: The same sizing with plain 20-day trailing volatility instead of the model: shows whether the model adds anything to a naive risk forecast.

earnings_classifier.name: earnings_classifier
earnings_classifier.label: Earnings classifier
earnings_classifier.description: Only on earnings reaction days: long or short by the sign of the classifier's expected reaction (date known in advance, numbers masked); in cash otherwise.
